verdict.rationale: Goodwin is a law firm, and Founders Workbench offers free founder resources: Document Driver formation documents plus capital and liquidation calculators. It is not an AI agent or host application, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers is outside its product category. The probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI surface, and nothing in the evidence suggests any agentic tool-use capability that would make this axis apply.
